device.description: 12-bit voltage-output DAC with TMS320/SPI serial interface (FS frame sync), programmable settling time and power down
device.note: tlv5616.pdf (SLAS152D) p.1 (D/DGK/P pinout, description), p.2 (terminal functions), p.3 (recommended operating conditions: VDD 2.7-3.3 V and 4.5-5.5 V, fCLK 20 MHz), p.5 (digital input timing requirements), p.6 (Figure 1 timing diagram), p.11 (power-on reset, serial interface), p.12 (data format)

registers.name: DAC
registers.note: DAC latch; power-on reset clears it (p.11)

registers.name: CTRL
registers.note: internal: SPD (1 = fast) and PWR (1 = power down) bits of the last word (p.12); power-on latches all zero (p.11)

commands.name: Write
commands.note: D15 X, D14 SPD, D13 PWR, D12 X, D11-D0 data (p.12)

protocol.note: FS falling starts the frame; data sampled MSB first on SCLK falling edges (SCLK idles high, Figure 1); after 16 bits the word moves to the DAC latch and updates the output (p.11)

pages: p.1 (D/DGK/P pinout, description), p.2 (terminal functions), p.3 (recommended operating conditions: VDD 2.7-3.3 V and 4.5-5.5 V, fCLK 20 MHz), p.5 (digital input timing requirements), p.6 (Figure 1 timing diagram), p.11 (power-on reset, serial interface), p.12 (data format)
notModeled: analog: voltage output (x2 buffer), reference input REFIN, settling speed (SPD) and power-down (PWR) effects on the output
CS (enable, active low) is not modeled: the bus frame is FS (FS falling starts a word, as in the datasheet's 3-wire connection with SS on FS and CS tied low); CS high does not block the model
a word cut short by FS rising before 16 bits (the datasheet moves the partial shift register to the DAC latch) is discarded
variants: tlv5616.pdf covers only the TLV5616 (C and I temperature grades), packages D/DGK/P share one pinout.
